acceptanceCriteria: The engine accepts requested shared-domain frequencies and renders exactly one selected fundamental at a time without allocations, blocking, file I/O, or UI-state mutation in the render callback.
Start, stop, pitch, and level changes use finite ramps or crossfades that prevent discontinuities; playback remains silent until explicit start.
Deterministic buffer tests qualify requested frequency, monophony, ramp continuity, amplitude bounds, clipping, and transition behavior.
notes: No timbre inventory, profile persistence, synchronization, authoring UI, microphone behavior, or background-mode entitlement implementation.
rationale: Accurate, safe, click-free tone generation is the core product capability.
testSteps: Run beta-toolchain package and platform-host deterministic buffer tests; record actual commands and distinguish physical listening evidence.

workItem.title: Implement monophonic render engine and deterministic signal qualification
